ITEM 1 | Pale off-white scrambled or cooked egg-like mass with bright yellow-orange streaks, soft and fluffy, clumped into irregular pieces spread across the upper right of the plate, about 10 cm across and 1.5 cm high, matte with slight moisture, sitting directly on the plate next to the sausages | 110
ITEM 2 | Five to six small round reddish-brown cylindrical pieces with smooth glossy casing and slightly wrinkled surface, some with faint browning, each about 2.5 cm in diameter and 2 cm tall, clustered together in the left center of the plate beside the egg | 90
ITEM 3 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of bright yellow cooked egg, soft and moist, about 2 cm across, lying on the plate at the lower center beside the sausage pieces | 8
